Ana (PM): quick sync — we need to rescore two competing Q2 things: A) hotfix for embedding degradation hitting Acme and BetaCorp, B) dedicated 'enterprise slice' feature for reserved throughput. can we agree criteria?
Matt (Eng Lead): hotfix = small surface area, high urgency. slice = big infra + rollout work.
Priya (Design): customer-facing UX for slice also nontrivial. blocked on decision for whether to prototype first.
Samir (Data): quick numbers: Acme+BetaCorp = ~18% revenue for the quarter; error spike increases failed requests by ~3.5% for them.
Lee (Sales): both customers flagged churn risk if hotfix not prioritized. slice has 10+ inbound deals but longer sales cycle.
Ana (PM): proposed RICE rescore this week and pick sequencing: hotfix -> canary -> slice backlog. want to hear counterarguments.
Matt (Eng Lead): counter: if we do hotfix now, we consume top-tier infra cycles; slice requires dedicated capacity planning that we can't gap later. risk of rework.
Priya (Design): can we split slice into MVP surface (metrics + config) vs full UX? maybe put MVP in Q2 if hotfix fast.
Samir (Data): rough RICE quick calc (handwave):
```
reach: hotfix = 0.18 (Acme+BetaCorp), slice = 0.35 (potential enterprise reach)
impact: hotfix = 6/10 (reduces churn), slice = 8/10 (new bookings)
confidence: hotfix = 70%, slice = 50%
effort: hotfix = 1.5 eng-weeks, slice = 8 eng-weeks
RICE score example = (reach * impact * confidence) / effort
```
Matt (Eng Lead): with those numbers hotfix looks higher priority short-term.
Lee (Sales): agree but we should protect the slice roadmap — customers in pipeline expect demos by end of Q2.
Ana (PM): proposal: 1) urgent hotfix with 2-day SLA, rollback plan + canary, 2) run a trimmed slice spike (2 sprints) to validate capacity + UI concept, 3) re-evaluate RICE end of sprint for final scope.
Priya (Design): I can deliver a prototype for spike in 1.5 sprints.
Matt (Eng Lead): technical plan: hotfix branch + feature-flagged deploy, add observability hook: `feature:embedding-hotfix-v1` and immediate perf test. deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2543211100.
deploy-bot: staging deploy queued by @Matt (Eng Lead) — job id 983212.
Samir (Data): I'll set up a canary metric dashboard and add the confidence calc to the RICE sheet.
Lee (Sales): I'll tell Acme/BetaCorp we have a hotfix plan and an MVP timeline for slice spike. keeps them calm.
Ana (PM): ok sounds like consensus. assign owners: Matt -> hotfix, Priya -> slice prototype, Samir -> metrics, Lee -> customer comms. check-in tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
Matt (Eng Lead): noted. starting hotfix branch now.
Priya (Design): adding prototype tasks to the slice epic.
Samir (Data): will post initial canary dashboard link here when ready.
Ana (PM): thanks all. we'll do a quick RICE re-score after spike and decide full slice commit.
Lee (Sales): thanks — will close the loop with Acme/BetaCorp.
Ana (PM): filing a brief doc after this thread with the final scores and rollout plan.
